coverage.measurements: bounded by models, accounting, hardware and sample scope
coverage.deployment: current Apple disclosure plus historical robotics examples; no population claim
coverage.skeptical_review: cost vs latency, information loss, limited oracles and activation privacy addressed
coverage.visuals: source pages, crops, rendering and exports reviewed; navigation regrouping checked with the companion page

open_questions: Real device and production network gains remain workload-dependent and unmeasured here.
New preprint results require independent replication; no universal best protocol established.
recommended_next_direction: Refresh mutable APIs, model pairs and device/network measurements before implementation; publication remains separately authorized.

output.audience: AI researchers and engineers designing local/cloud systems

validation.method: Pinned Node24.21.0 npm run validate and schema3 validator passed; git diff --check clean.

rendering.method: Built-site Chromium desktop/mobile light/dark, focus, keyboard panning, reduced motion, explorer filtering/no-JS, images and local anchors checked; actual screenshots reviewed.

exports.method: Complete Markdown/MDX, math, citations, all figures/flow steps, table rows and discovery indexes checked; search finds route.
